name: XLSX Editor
description: Open and edit Excel workbooks in Orca with their formatting: fills, fonts, borders, number formats, merged cells, frozen panes and every sheet. Saves in place without touching the parts it did not edit. Hands a selection or a sheet to an agent in your workspace as a Markdown table or TSV.

cover.alt: A ledger workbook in the editor: painted header, banded rows with borders, currency and percentage columns, frozen panes, and the copy and export controls

screenshots.alt: A ledger with a painted header, alternating row fills, thin borders and formatted numbers
